surface_name: Claude Code on Google Cloud Agent Platform
title: Sonnet requests on Agent Platform go to the wrong region after 2.1.332 when only the 4_5 region variable is set
symptoms: Sonnet requests hit us-east5 or CLOUD_ML_REGION instead of your chosen region
Region-specific quota or model-not-found errors after upgrading to 2.1.332
cause: The sonnet alias and background requests now resolve to Sonnet 5.5 and read VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_5_SONNET. If only the VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_5_SONNET variable is set, they fall back to CLOUD_ML_REGION or us-east5.
fix: Set the new 5.5 region variable to the same region you used for 4.5.
affected: Claude Code 2.1.332 and later on Google Cloud Agent Platform
